battle.name: 普法戰爭
battle.brief: 1870年7月19日法國向普魯士宣戰，戰線自洛林推向巴黎。卡面是1840年法軍改用雷管的前膛線膛步槍，此時已退居次要；決定色當與梅斯勝負的，是1866年列裝的Chassepot栓動後膛槍與普軍針發後膛步槍，砲兵差距則是法軍敗因。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 普法戰爭自1870年7月19日開打，到1871年1月28日凡爾賽停戰、5月10日《法蘭克福條約》生效為止，交戰的其實是兩套聯盟體系。北面是北德意志聯邦，以普魯士王國為核心：普軍由國王威廉一世以總司令身分統率，俾斯麥任首相兼外交大臣主持政治面，總參謀長毛奇擬定作戰計劃，陸軍部長克魯格掌軍制、徵兵與後勤。戰事爆發後，原本與法國訂有攻守密約的南德三邦——巴伐利亞、符騰堡、巴登——依條約站到普魯士一方，戰爭由兩國對決變成以普魯士為首的德意志聯盟對法國。南面是法蘭西第二帝國，拿破崙三世以陸軍元帥身分任最高統帥，但指揮系統極為分散：帝國參謀總部、陸軍部與財政部各自主張權責，邊境戰役階段的野戰軍由麥克馬洪元帥實際指揮，他與陸軍部長勒布伊之間長期互相猜忌，成為決策遲滯的著名原因。1870年9月4日帝國崩潰後，法國改組為共和國，梯也爾出任「國民防禦」政府首腦，軍隊由帝國常備軍、國民警衛隊與大批志願兵拼湊而成，編制、訓練與指揮都不統一。戰後北德意志聯邦升格為德意志帝國，法國則在共和體制下重整軍備。
countriesEn: The Franco-Prussian War ran from 19 July 1870 to the armistice signed at Versailles on 28 January 1871, and ended with the Treaty of Frankfurt taking effect on 10 May; the two sides were in truth two alliance systems. In the north stood the North German Confederation, built around the Kingdom of Prussia: the Prussian army was led in the field by King Wilhelm I as commander-in-chief, Otto von Bismarck was prime minister and foreign minister, Helmuth von Moltke the Elder was chief of the general staff, and Albrecht von Roon was war minister responsible for army reform, conscription and logistics. When hostilities began, the three southern German states of Bavaria, Württemberg and Baden, bound to France by secret defensive alliances, declared for Prussia instead, so the war became a German alliance under Prussian leadership facing France rather than a plain duel between two states. On the other side stood the Second French Empire under Napoleon III, who acted as supreme commander in the capacity of marshal of the empire, but the command system was badly divided: the imperial headquarters, the war ministry and the finance ministry each claimed a share in the conduct of the war, and in the frontier phase the field army was led in practice by Marshal Patrice de MacMahon, whose long-standing mistrust of the war minister Le Bœuf slowed every decision. After the empire collapsed on 4 September 1870 France became a republic: Adolphe Thiers headed a National Defence government, and the new military system was an improvised mixture of the old regular army, the National Guard and large numbers of volunteers, uneven in organisation, training and command. After the war the North German Confederation was raised to the German Empire, and France set about rebuilding its army under the republic.
people: 德方真正決定戰局的是三個人。普魯士首相俾斯麥自1867年北德意志聯邦成立後推行「鐵血政策」，本役前一年處理西班牙王位糾紛時，他刻意把一份電報加工成兩個版本分別交給法國代表與北德輿論，使原本可以外交收場的爭端迅速升溫；他的目標是讓法國先動手，把一場法國外交孤立下的普法衝突變成全歐洲無法迴避的重大事件。總參謀長毛奇把普軍戰略從分界線式改為分遣隊式：軍隊不再沿一條連續戰線對峙，而是以獨立軍團分散駐紮、平行行軍，待各軍團完成集結，再由參謀部指定時刻讓數個方向同時投入同一戰區，色當的三面合圍就是這套作法的樣本。陸軍部長克魯格則在1860至1867年的改革中打通常備軍、後備軍與地方民兵之間的隔閡，使普軍在1870年8月仍能迅速擴充番號、補充兵員。法方的關鍵人物是拿破崙三世、麥克馬洪與梯也爾：拿破崙三世在色當受傷並於9月2日被俘，帝國隨之瓦解；梯也爾在9月4日之後以共和國首腦身分收拾局面，一面向普軍爭取停戰，一面靠巴黎與凡爾賽的徵召維持國防，最終在1871年1月28日接受停戰。福煦在1870年8月初的魏森堡一役還只是一名旅長，卻因在最不利的局面下穩住洛林前線而開始嶄露頭角。
peopleEn: On the German side the war was effectively decided by three men. Otto von Bismarck, Prussian prime minister since the creation of the North German Confederation in 1867, had pursued his iron-and-blood policy; a year before this war, while handling the Spanish succession crisis, he deliberately rewrote a single telegram into two versions, one for the French envoy and one for the North German press, so that a dispute which might have been settled by diplomacy quickly became explosive. His aim was to make France strike first, turning a Franco-Prussian conflict into an affair on which all of Europe had to take notice. Chief of the general staff Helmuth von Moltke reorganised Prussian strategy from a boundary model to a dispatch model: instead of holding one continuous front, the army was split into independent corps, dispersed and marching in parallel, which the staff then committed to the same theatre of operations at a fixed hour; the three-sided pincer at Sedan was the classic example of the method. War minister Albrecht von Roon, through the reforms of 1860 to 1867, had broken down the barrier between the regular army, the reserves and the provincial militia, so that Prussia could still expand its formations and fill its ranks quickly in August 1870. On the French side the decisive personalities were Napoleon III, de MacMahon and Thiers. Napoleon III was wounded at Sedan and taken prisoner on 2 September, and the empire collapsed with him. Thiers, as head of the republic after 4 September, gathered what was left of the state's strength, pressing for an armistice while holding Paris and Versailles together through mass conscription, and finally accepting terms on 28 January 1871. Ferdinand Foch, then only a brigade commander, first drew attention in the fighting around Weissenburg in early August 1870, when he steadied the Lorraine front in a situation that was going badly.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是法國1840年型的雷管步槍。法國在1840年代完成從火燧到雷管的改裝，1840年制式步槍仍屬前膛裝填的線膛槍，擊發機構改用雷管火帽，射程較火燧時代為佳，也能在潮濕與多霧的環境中可靠發射，這正是簡介中所說的底火在霧裡也打得響；射程變長，隊形就散了，因為散兵線一旦拉開，單發後膛步槍的射速便跟不上縱隊行軍的節奏。到1870年，1840年型的雷管槍早已退居次要，大量退入庫存，由國民兵、警衛與後勤單位使用，或在徵召新兵時作為過渡裝備發放。真正決定色當與洛林戰役勝負的，是法軍1866年開始配發的Chassepot栓動後膛槍，以及普軍的針發後膛步槍。Chassepot口徑約十一毫米，槍管上有多條刻溝、槍機採手動前推式，性能遠勝任何前膛槍，但它槍機結構複雜、連續射擊時容易卡膛，加上產量遠跟不上需求，多數部隊開戰時只配到十幾萬挺，用一發少一發。普軍裝備的是更老但更可靠的針發後膛步槍，主要為1857與1860年型，1870年初已配發逾二十萬枝：它靠一根撞針完成閉鎖，射速慢、射程近，但結構簡單、備彈充足、維修容易，在彈藥不繼的逆境中反而比精貴的新槍更能撐住戰線。砲兵方面的差距更大，普軍大量裝備Krupp鑄鋼後膛線膛砲，野戰砲多為五磅與六磅，射程遠、重量輕、可藉蒸汽與鐵路大量輸送，1870至1871年間Krupp的產量以千門計；法軍野戰砲主力是九十毫米與一百二十毫米加納砲，採前膛裝填、後坐裝置簡陋，1870年12月才有短後膛加納砲抵達前線，砲兵的落後是法軍在邊境戰役失利的技術原因之一。此外普軍在騎兵偵察、輕野戰砲、工兵支援與野戰電報上全面現代化，法軍則仍受制於馬匹、徵召與軍需運輸的瓶頸。戰爭結束前後，普軍換裝新式後膛步槍，1870年代末已完全取代針發槍；法軍也著手改造，但新槍未及在戰事中發揮作用。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the French Model 1840 percussion rifle. France completed the change from flintlock to percussion during the 1840s, and the 1840 service rifle remained a muzzleloader with a rifled barrel whose ignition had been converted to a percussion cap; its range was better than that of the flintlock era and it fired reliably in damp and foggy weather, which is exactly what the description of this piece emphasises: the primer went off even in fog, and once the range increased the formations had to spread, because a spread skirmish line could no longer be fed at the rate of fire of a single-shot breechloader. By 1870 the 1840 percussion rifle had long been demoted: most went into stores and were issued to the National Guard, to guards and to service units, or handed out as stopgap equipment to newly raised men. What really decided the fighting at Sedan and in Lorraine was the Chassepot, the bolt-action breechloader the French army began to issue in 1866, and the Prussian needle breechloader. The Chassepot, of roughly eleven millimetres bore, had multiple rifling grooves and a hand-operated forward-sliding bolt and outperformed every muzzleloader; but its action was complicated, was prone to jamming under rapid fire, and 1870 production was nowhere near enough, so most units entered the campaign with barely a hundred thousand rifles and every round had to be husbanded. Prussia carried the older but far more reliable needle breechloader, chiefly the 1857 and 1860 patterns, of which more than two hundred thousand were in service by the early months of 1870: it closed on a single needle, was slow to fire and short-ranged, but it was simple, was well supplied with ammunition and was easy to repair, so in a battle starved of shells it held the line better than a delicate new rifle. The gap in artillery was wider still. Prussia equipped large numbers of Krupp cast-steel rifled breechloaders, with five- and six-pounder field guns, longer-ranged, lighter and transportable by steam and railway; Krupp output over 1870 and 1871 is counted in thousands. French field artillery relied on 90 and 120 millimetre de Bange guns, muzzleloaders with a primitive recoil system, and the short Bange breechloaders only reached the front in December 1870. The technical backwardness of French artillery was one of the reasons for the defeat in the frontier battles. Prussia was also modern in cavalry scouting, light field guns, pioneer support and the field telegraph, while France was hamstrung by shortages of horses, of conscription and of transport. Around the end of the war the Prussian army began to re-equip with new breech-loading rifles that displaced the needle gun entirely by the end of the 1870s; France began the same work, but its new rifles never fought in this war.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術骨架，是普軍參謀部用鐵路與道路算出的行軍表。普軍不把全軍集中在一條戰線上，而是把野戰軍編為獨立軍團，分散駐紮、平行行軍，待各軍團完成集結，再指定時刻同時投入同一戰區；通訊依靠騎兵參謀、傳令兵與野戰電報，1860年代起已配發到軍團一級。色當之役是這套戰法的教科書：第二軍團自北面翻越阿登納山壓向法軍右翼，第三軍團自南面沿山地向色當迂迴，第一軍團封住西面通往法國腹地的退路，正面只以適量兵力牽制，待法軍被三面包圍、補給線被切斷，才發動總攻。與此同時，普軍另一支重兵集團自9月起封鎖法國東境要塞，把法軍主力分割在梅斯、凡爾賽與巴黎三處。法軍這邊的戰術幾乎全是帝國時代的遺留：步兵以密集縱隊行軍，抵達陣前才展開成射擊線；Chassepot射程遠的優勢因彈藥不足而無法發揮，砲兵分散且前膛裝填使射速受限，部隊之間缺乏統一訊號，野戰指揮與軍政指揮混雜，色當之謎常被後人視為協調失敗的樣本。當戰爭轉入包圍與圍城，雙方都大量使用大口徑攻城砲與鐵路炮，把海軍重炮改裝上車架沿鐵路緩慢行進、對準要塞射擊；1871年1月梯也爾在巴黎試圖向北突圍，先有10月28日盧瓦尼與拉巴塔耶之役，1月底又有瓦茲河一役，皆告失敗，法軍最後一次大規模戰術反擊是1871年2月1至2日的利贊河戰役，結果同樣不利。戰爭末段，德軍以十一個軍團在法國境內展開，連續實施機動作戰，迫使法軍在劣勢兵力下連續應戰。
tacticsEn: The tactical skeleton of this war was a marching timetable worked out by the Prussian staff from railways and roads. The Prussian army did not concentrate on a single front; it split the field army into independent corps, dispersed and marching in parallel, and then committed them simultaneously to the same theatre of operations at a fixed hour. Communications ran through staff cavalry, mounted orderlies and the field telegraph, which by the 1860s had reached corps headquarters. The battle of Sedan is the textbook case: the Second Army pressed down on the French right through the Ardennes from the north, the Third Army wheeled around the southern approaches to Sedan, and the First Army closed the road west into the French interior. Only enough troops were kept in front to pin the enemy down, and the final assault was launched only after the French had been enveloped on three sides and their line of supply cut. At the same time a second German force sealed the French fortresses on the eastern frontier, splitting the French army into three separate bodies at Metz, Versailles and Paris. French tactics were almost entirely inherited from the Empire: infantry marched in dense columns and deployed into a firing line only on arrival; the range advantage of the Chassepot could not be exploited for want of ammunition; the artillery was dispersed and its muzzleloading limited the rate of fire; signals between formations were poor; and field command was mixed up with administrative command. The so-called enigma of Sedan is usually treated as the type case of that failure of coordination. Once the war turned to blockade and siege, both sides used heavy siege guns and railway artillery, naval pieces remounted on carriages and moved slowly along the track to bear on fortresses. Thiers' attempt to break out northwards from Paris, first at Loigny-la-Bataille on 28 October 1870 and then on the Oise at the end of January 1871, failed, and the last large French tactical counter-stroke, the battle of the Lisaine on 1 and 2 February 1871, ended no better. In the closing phase the German army fought in France with eleven corps, pursuing a war of movement that forced the French to meet one defeat after another with inferior forces.
data: 先記幾個比較可靠的數字。戰爭自1870年7月19日法國宣戰起，到1871年1月28日凡爾賽停戰協議簽訂、5月10日《法蘭克福條約》生效為止，前後約十個月。1870年8月初，普軍投入前線的野戰兵力一般記載約二十一萬人，到9月初色當周邊三個軍團展開的兵力已超過二十萬；同期法軍在邊境一線以帝國陸軍三十九個師為骨架，紙面數字超過六十萬，但其中相當一部分是未受訓的民兵與新徵召的預備役，實際能打的不到紙面數字的一半，缺馬、缺炮、缺彈是普遍狀況。色當一役，法軍陣亡與重傷約二千餘人，被俘人數在八萬至十萬之間，常見說法是作戰部隊被俘約八萬三千、連同非戰鬥人員合計逾十萬，一個整軍集團自此不復存在。梅斯方面，1870年10月27日守軍投降，約八萬人被解除武裝，凡爾賽的堡壘同時陷落。1870年9月19日開始的巴黎之圍持續到1871年1月28日，梯也爾在凡爾賽集結的突圍部隊一般記載在八萬至十萬之間。槍械方面，法軍到1870年8月只配發了約十五萬挺Chassepot，戰爭期間總產量不過二十餘萬挺；普軍1870年初可用步槍約三十一萬枝，多數是針發後膛槍，彈藥缺口以百萬發計，後來主要靠英國購運補足。砲兵方面，一般記載Krupp在1870至1871兩年間生產的後膛線膛砲超過一千五百門，而法國在整場戰爭中的後膛砲產量遠不足以彌補缺口，無法在短期內換裝整個砲兵部隊。戰後法國割讓亞爾薩斯全境及洛林一部分，面積約佔法國本土的百分之五上下，並賠償五十億法郎，分期支付至1913年。
dataEn: A few figures are reasonably well attested. The war ran from the French declaration of war on 19 July 1870 to the armistice signed at Versailles on 28 January 1871, and ended with the Treaty of Frankfurt taking effect on 10 May, a matter of about ten months. In early August 1870 the Prussian field force in the front line is generally given as about 213,000 men; by the beginning of September the three armies deployed around Sedan numbered well over 200,000. On the French side the force in the frontier line rested on the thirty-nine infantry divisions of the imperial army, a paper strength of more than 600,000, but a large part of that consisted of untrained guardsmen and newly called-up reservists, so the troops that could actually fight were less than half the paper figure, and shortages of horses, of guns and of shells were universal. At Sedan the French lost about two thousand men killed and wounded, and the number taken prisoner lay between eighty and a hundred thousand, the figures usually quoted being some eighty-three thousand combatants captured and over a hundred thousand counting non-combatants; an entire army group ceased to exist. At Metz the garrison capitulated on 27 October 1870 and about eighty thousand men were disarmed, while the fortress of Versailles fell at the same time. The siege of Paris, which opened on 19 September 1870, lasted until 28 January 1871, and the force Thiers assembled at Versailles for the breakout is generally put at between eighty and a hundred thousand men. In the matter of small arms, the French had received only about 150,000 Chassepot rifles by August 1870 and total production during the war did not exceed a quarter of a million; the Prussians had roughly 310,000 service rifles in the early months of 1870, mostly needle guns, and their ammunition deficit ran into millions of rounds, filled in the main by purchases carried from Britain. In artillery it is generally recorded that Krupp produced more than fifteen hundred rifled breechloaders in 1870 and 1871, while French output of breechloaders over the whole war fell far short of that and could not re-equip the artillery in time. After the war France ceded the whole of Alsace and part of Lorraine, roughly five per cent of her own territory, and agreed an indemnity of five thousand million francs, payable in instalments until 1913.
cause: 直接引爆點是西班牙王位。1868年西班牙革命推翻女王伊莎貝二世，1870年2月退位，歐洲列強在馬德里尋找新王。普魯士與法國先後推舉霍亨索倫-西格馬林根家族的利奧波德親王競逐，俾斯麥起初並不熱心，他真正在意的是西班牙的戰略位置對德國的地中海通道構成威脅。俾斯麥同意候選，等的正是法國跳進陷阱：法國要求北德意志聯邦承諾永不支持霍亨索倫家族成西班牙王，並要求俾斯麥本人到巴黎接受問責。7月13日在埃姆斯碰商的電報被俾斯麥改寫成兩個版本，刪去了原本可以調解的語氣，交給法國代表的一版被北德輿論視為侮辱，7月19日法國國會批准宣戰。這背後是更長的結構性矛盾：1864至1866年普丹戰爭與德意志戰爭之後，俾斯麥以鐵血政策排除法國在歐洲大陸的影響，而法國正想在歐洲建立以己為首的聯盟體系；同時北德意志聯邦軍改後的三年役制、常備軍擴編、總參謀長制度與鐵路網，讓普軍在兵役體制與技術上全面佔優，一旦開戰，勝負在開火之前就已有預感。戰爭的另一半原因在德國內部：南德三邦與法國訂有秘密互助條約，普魯士擔心戰時它們倒向巴黎，於是借開戰之機同時解決內部統一問題，南德三邦的加入，使德意志帝國的成立由內政議題變成戰爭的既成事實。
causeEn: The immediate spark was the Spanish throne. The revolution of 1868 overthrew Queen Isabella II, who abdicated in February 1870, and the powers of Europe went looking for a new king in Madrid. Prussia and France in turn backed the candidacy of Prince Leopold of Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen. Bismarck was at first lukewarm, for what really concerned him was the strategic position of Spain on Germany's approaches to the Mediterranean. He consented to the candidacy because he was waiting for France to walk into the trap: Paris demanded that the North German Confederation give an assurance that no Hohenzollern would ever occupy the Spanish throne, and demanded that Bismarck himself come to the French capital to answer for it. The dispatch negotiated at Ems on 13 July was rewritten by Bismarck into two versions, the conciliatory passages stripped out; the version handed to the French envoy was read in the North German press as an insult, and on 19 July the French chamber authorised war. Behind that lay a longer structural antagonism: after the Danish War of 1864 and the Austro-Prussian War of 1866, Bismarck's iron-and-blood policy sought to exclude France from European affairs, while France was trying to build a continent-wide alliance under its own leadership. At the same time the military reforms of the North German Confederation, with three years of service, an expanded regular army, the general staff system and a dense railway network, put Prussia ahead of France in both manning and technology, so that once the guns fired the outcome had been broadly decided in advance. The war had a second purpose inside Germany: Bavaria, Württemberg and Baden were bound to France by secret mutual defence treaties, and Prussia feared they might side with Paris when the test came. Opening the war at once disposed of the question of German unity, for the accession of the three southern states turned the creation of a German empire from a matter of domestic politics into a fait accompli of the battlefield.
impact: 第一重影響在政治。1871年1月18日北德意志聯邦宣告成立德意志帝國，威廉一世於3月18日在凡爾賽的鏡廳加冕，在敵國的宮殿裡舉行皇帝加冕典禮，成為法國國家記憶中最尖銳的一個符號。共和國在法國的第三共和體制自此長期受軍隊的猜疑與制衡，1871年3月巴黎的公社事件即是其後果之一；德軍在法國境內的佔領一直維持到1873年。第二重影響在軍事，戰爭暴露了針發後膛槍的缺陷，1870年代起新式金屬殼後膛步槍迅速取代它，普軍1871年式毛瑟步槍即是代表，德軍的兵役制度與三年役體制隨後被俄國、法國、義大利等國仿效，歐洲整體進入全民皆兵的時代；法國在1872年也通過自己的三年兵役法，重建常備軍。第三重影響在經濟與地緣，洛林的鐵礦在割讓之後成為德國工業的骨架，德國鋼鐵產量在1890年代躍居世界首位，關稅同盟與歐洲大陸的市場格局亦隨之改變；法國則把這場敗仗視為民族屈辱，1870至1914年間的每一次外交結算都帶著收回失地的影子，這條線最終通向1919年的凡爾賽和約。總體戰的技術前提也在此役成形：總參謀長體制、鐵路行軍、強制徵用民間車輛、全國動員與攻城砲的使用，說明一場工業化國家的戰爭已經可以動員整個社會，而1870年的步兵戰術仍停留在線性射擊與刺刀衝鋒的舊世界裡，兩種時間觀的落差，構成此後半個世紀歐洲軍事的底色。
impactEn: The first effect was political. On 18 January 1871 the North German Confederation proclaimed the German Empire, and Wilhelm I was crowned in the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles on 18 March; an imperial coronation held in a palace belonging to the enemy became the sharpest symbol in French national memory. The Third Republic born of the defeat long suspected the army and was curbed by it, and the Paris Commune of March 1871 was one of its consequences, while German troops occupied French soil until 1873. The second effect was military: the war exposed the defects of the needle gun, and from the 1870s the new all-metal breech-loading rifle displaced it rapidly, the Prussian Model 1871 Mauser being the pattern, while the German system of long service and three-year liability was copied by Russia, France, Italy and others, so that Europe entered the era of the mass army; France passed its own three-year service law in 1872 and rebuilt its regular army. The third effect was economic and geopolitical. The iron mines of Lorraine, ceded with the territory, became the skeleton of German industry; German steel output took first place in the world during the 1890s, and the customs union and the pattern of continental markets shifted with it. France regarded the defeat as a national humiliation, and every diplomatic reckoning between 1870 and 1914 carried the shadow of a demand to recover the lost provinces, a line that ultimately runs to the Treaty of Versailles in 1919. The preconditions of total war were also formed here: the general staff system, movement by rail, the compulsory requisition of civilian vehicles, national mobilisation and the use of siege artillery showed that the war of an industrialised state could now draw on the whole of society, while the infantry tactics of 1870 remained those of the linear volley and the bayonet charge. The gap between those two conceptions of time coloured European military affairs for the next half century.
result: 1871年1月28日，梯也爾在凡爾賽與俾斯麥、毛奇簽訂停戰協議：法國割讓亞爾薩斯全境與洛林北部，賠償五十億法郎，軍隊解除武裝，凡爾賽政府遷回巴黎；5月10日《法蘭克福條約》生效，戰爭至此結束，德軍於1873年3月完成最後撤離。軍事結果是決定性的，法國在色當丟掉整個帝國陸軍的野戰主力，在梅斯丟掉約八萬人，在巴黎被圍困四個多月，最後一場利贊河戰役也未能扭轉局面。法國戰敗的原因被當時人歸納為幾條：政治上由帝國制度下的個人獨斷造成戰爭不可避免，戰前把一場可以外交收場的爭端變成了民族戰爭；軍事上指揮系統分立，陸軍部與野戰指揮互不信任，決策一再延誤；技術上後膛步槍的普及程度與砲兵落後最致命，法國雖有射程與精度更佳的Chassepot，卻無法解決產量與彈藥問題，而普軍用性能較次但便宜可靠、備彈充足的針發後膛槍與大量Krupp線膛後膛砲，憑工業產量與動員效率取勝。結果還有更深的一層，德意志統一在戰爭中完成，歐洲列強的均勢被推倒重排，法國失去了它在歐洲大陸的傳統主導地位，而它對此的接受與否，正構成本後數十年歐洲外交的主軸。軍事上，1870年這場戰爭也給人一種虛假的教訓，以為軸線射擊與刺刀衝鋒仍能決定戰局；實際的教訓要到1870年代末的技術變化、1880年代的機槍與新式步槍普及之後，才由下一場大規模戰爭重新確認。
resultEn: On 28 January 1871 Thiers signed the armistice at Versailles with Bismarck and Moltke: France ceded the whole of Alsace and the north of Lorraine, agreed an indemnity of five thousand million francs, disarmed her army, and the government of Versailles returned to Paris. On 10 May the Treaty of Frankfurt took effect, the war was over, and the last German troops withdrew in March 1873. The military result was decisive. France lost the field army of the Empire entire at Sedan, lost some eighty thousand men at Metz, was shut up in Paris for more than four months, and failed to retrieve the situation in the last battle on the Lisaine. The causes of the defeat were summarised at the time in several terms. Politically, personal autocracy under the Empire, in which a dispute that might have been settled by diplomacy was turned into a national war, had made the conflict unavoidable. Militarily, the command was split, with the war ministry and the field command mistrusting one another and decisions delayed again and again. Technically, the degree of service given to the breech-loading rifle and the backwardness of the artillery were fatal: France held the better rifle in the Chassepot, with its superior range and accuracy, but could not solve the problem of output and supply, while Prussia won on industrial output and speed of mobilisation with cheaper and more reliable needle rifles and a large number of Krupp rifled breechloaders. The result had a deeper level as well: German unification was completed by the war, the balance of the European powers was overthrown and rearranged, France lost her traditional primacy on the continent, and whether she accepted that became the main axis of European diplomacy for the following decades. Militarily too, 1870 offered a false lesson, that volley fire and the bayonet still decided battles; the true lesson was confirmed only by the next great war, after the technological changes of the late 1870s and the spread of the machine gun and the new service rifle in the 1880s.
